stories.title: Appearance of Arabian Gulf Cup trophy adds to rising excitement in Jeddah

en.title: Appearance of Arabian Gulf Cup trophy adds to rising excitement in Jeddah
en.summary: The Arabian Gulf Cup 27 tournament will be held in Jeddah from September 23 to October 6, with the trophy making a special appearance in the city as part of fan activation events ahead of the competition.

stories.title: Saudi building permits jump 15.5 percent in July as operating revenues rise

en.title: Saudi building permits jump 15.5 percent in July as operating revenues rise
en.summary: Saudi Arabia issued 5,828 building permits in July 2026, representing a 15.5 percent increase from June's 5,045 permits, according to government statistics.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s Operating Revenues Index rises 4.9% in July: GASTAT

en.title: Saudi Arabia's Operating Revenues Index rises 4.9% in July: GASTAT
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Operating Revenues Index increased 4.9 percent in July compared to the previous year, driven by growth in manufacturing and financial services sectors.

stories.title: Seoul: NKorea Fires Ballistic Missile Into East Sea

en.title: Seoul: NKorea Fires Ballistic Missile Into East Sea
en.summary: North Korea conducted a ballistic missile test into the East Sea, according to South Korean authorities.

stories.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia

en.title: Arab and Islamic world condemns Houthi attacks; affirms support for Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Multiple Arab nations and Islamic organizations condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including a ballistic missile attempt on Riyadh and strikes on civilian areas. Yemen, Kuwait, Egypt, Bahrain, Lebanon, and Jordan issued statements expressing solidarity with Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: UN Security Council Condemns Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: The UN Security Council issued a condemnation of Houthi attacks directed at Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: North Korea fires unidentified projectile into East Sea: Seoul

en.title: North Korea fires unidentified projectile into East Sea: Seoul
en.summary: South Korea's military reported that North Korea launched an unidentified projectile into the East Sea following recent missile activity and after Pyongyang dismissed an international resolution.

stories.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh

en.title: Saudi air defenses intercept Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's air defense forces destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Houthi militants toward Riyadh on Saturday morning. Coalition officials characterized the attack as part of an escalating pattern of Houthi strikes against civilian targets.

stories.title: Gulf, UN Condemnation of Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Gulf, UN Condemnation of Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Gulf states and the United Nations have condemned Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Coalition Destroys Ballistic Missile Fired by Houthis at Riyadh

en.title: Coalition Destroys Ballistic Missile Fired by Houthis at Riyadh
en.summary: A coalition supporting Yemen's government intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by Houthi forces toward Riyadh.

stories.title: Coalition intercepts and destroys ballistic missile fired toward Riyadh

en.title: Coalition intercepts and destroys ballistic missile fired toward Riyadh
en.summary: A coalition backing Yemen's internationally-recognized government destroyed a ballistic missile fired by Houthis at Riyadh without reported damage, according to a coalition spokesperson.

stories.title: UNSC condemns Houthi attacks; affirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia in confronting aggression

en.title: UNSC condemns Houthi attacks; affirms solidarity with Saudi Arabia in confronting aggression
en.summary: The UN Security Council condemned attacks by Houthi militia against Saudi Arabia and expressed solidarity with the kingdom's right to self-defense under international law.

stories.title: ‎Saudi ports handle 341M tons of cargo in 2025: GASTAT

en.title: Saudi ports handle 341M tons of cargo in 2025: GASTAT
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's seaborne cargo reached 341 million tons in 2025, with outbound shipments rising 2% to 227.2 million tons and inbound volumes increasing 5% to 114.3 million tons. King Fahd Industrial Port in Yanbu and King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam led in exports and imports respectively.

en.title: ADF approves SAR 600M loans in Q3 2026
en.summary: The Agricultural Development Fund approved SAR 600 million in loans during the third quarter of 2026 to finance agricultural activities including meat production facilities, livestock markets, and cold storage infrastructure aimed at strengthening domestic food security.

stories.title: ‎TASI: 12 stocks, 1 REIT fall to all-time lows

en.title: TASI: 12 stocks, 1 REIT fall to all-time lows
en.summary: Twelve companies and one real estate investment fund listed on Saudi Arabia's main stock exchange reached their lowest prices since their respective listings on September 20, with declines ranging from 39% to 58% year-to-date.

en.title: TASI: 19 stocks fall to 52-week lows
en.summary: Nineteen companies trading on Saudi Arabia's main stock exchange fell to their lowest levels in the past 52 weeks on September 20, with declines ranging from 14% to 50% over the period.

stories.title: ‎Keir recommends 72% capital cut to offset accumulated losses

en.title: Keir recommends 72% capital cut to offset accumulated losses
en.summary: Keir International Co.'s board recommended reducing the company's capital by 72.018% through cancellation of 86.42 million shares to offset accumulated losses and restructure the capital.
